config.title: FUNDA — Star Rating Input

intro.title: FUNDA — Star Rating Input
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Star Rating Input — a five-star clickable rating widget that integrates seamlessly with Angular's Reactive Forms API. It works like a native input: it accepts formControlName in a parent form, responds to form.patchValue(), participates in form validity, and disables itself when the parent FormGroup is disabled. Implementing ControlValueAccessor is the only correct way to plug a custom UI component into Angular Forms.
intro.usecase: Custom form controls are everywhere in enterprise applications — date pickers, colour inputs, rich-text editors, file upload inputs, and rating widgets. ControlValueAccessor is running under the hood whenever you use Angular Material's custom inputs.

objectives: Register the StarRatingComponent as a NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR provider using useExisting and forwardRef()
Implement writeValue() to render the correct number of filled stars when the form sets a value programmatically
Implement registerOnChange() and call the registered callback whenever the user clicks a star
Implement registerOnTouched() and mark the control as touched on the first user interaction
Implement setDisabledState() to visually disable the stars and block click events when the parent form is disabled
Use the widget inside a Reactive Form with formControlName and verify that patchValue() updates the displayed stars
Add hover-preview behaviour (highlight stars on hover before click) using @HostListener without breaking the form contract
